newsitem.title: GERMANY: Daimler chief stands by Smart car project.
newsitem.headline: Daimler chief stands by Smart car project.

text.p: STUTTGART, Germany, (May 28) - Daimler-Benz AG Chairman Juergen Schrempp said on Wednesday the company's joint venture to build the ultra-small "Smart" model car was a "calculated adventure" that should not be passed up.

Speaking at Daimler's annual shareholder meeting, Schrempp said the two-seat Smart car being made with Switzerland's SMH AG was a completely new concept which will have a unique place in the car market.
"We do not have anything against adventure, as long as it can be reasonably controlled," Schrempp said.
Schrempp said that if Daimler did not go ahead with the project that someone else would.
